description: Native LM-over-G compact monogram beneath the retained coupe-roof motif

Keep monochrome italic angular "LMG" identity and the coupe-roof/car-line motif. Exact new compact layout: a small strong coupe roof above two-row lettering "LM" on top and large "G" below, reading L-M-G. Capital G MUST have clear interior horizontal crossbar, never C. Draw native new tall glyph geometry, no stretched pixels. Overall roof+LM+G occupies85-90% square width AND75-85% square height with balanced5-8% margins. Dominant solid black/dark charcoal ink for white background; no pale fills. Bold simplified strokes/transparent counters and exact recognizable letters clear at32px. Actual transparent alpha, no background tile/badge, no small business-name words, gradient, shadows, glow, haze or speckles. Preserve existing dealer initials and roof motif, no new icon.

Use case: logo-brand. Input1 is EDIT TARGET: exact new compact Leicester LMG/roof mark. Change ONLY ink to a high-contrast inverse for dark/red surfaces. Preserve the exact coupe roof motif and stacked "LM" above "G" geometry, all italic angular letter forms, clear G crossbar, placement, natural proportions, compact square canvas and transparent counters. Exact reading L-M-G. Dominant all visible ink clean solid very-light ivory/silver (#e3e7ee feel), over95% light, no dark filling. Actual transparent alpha, crisp filled strokes, clear at32px on #111113,#101820,#09090b,#17191c,#c40101. No gradient, gloss, shadow, glow, haze, white spray speckles, badge or backing tile. Do not stretch, rearrange or add anything.

Use case: logo-brand. Input1 is EDIT TARGET, existing Leicester Motor Group full wordmark. Produce an actual high-contrast transparent inverse, preserving exact composition, all existing natural geometry, italic angular font, car-line/coupe roof above LMG at LEFT, and two-line business wording RIGHT. Text verbatim: "LMG", "LEICESTER", "MOTOR GROUP LTD". Preserve exact spelling L-E-I-C-E-S-T-E-R and all spacing/proportions. Change dominant ink only to solid very-light cool silver/ivory (#e3e7ee feel), over95% visible ink light, so ALL text and emblem work on #111113,#101820,#09090b,#17191c and #c40101. True transparent alpha; no background tile, dark fills, gray outlines dominating lettering, shadows, gradient, glow, haze or alpha speckles. Clear at120px and180px.
